scripts.build: npm run build -w @learn/shared && npm run build -w @learn/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @learn/shared && npm run typecheck -w @learn/api
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @learn/api
scripts.content:check: npm run build --silent && node api/dist/cli/content.js check
scripts.content:sync: npm run build --silent && node --env-file-if-exists=api/.env api/dist/cli/content.js sync
scripts.schema:export: npm run build -w @learn/shared && node shared/dist/export-json-schema.js content/_schema
